title: Fixed Direct Hub Crank and Saddle Unicycle
description: One newly authored complete fixed direct-hub unicycle appearance. A full annular faceted tyre with actual finite flat bottom tread surrounds an open rim, twelve complete spokes and a broad hub. One continuous transverse axle connects that hub directly to two opposed crank arms and separate whole thick pedals. A single complete U crown fork passes around the tyre and rises to one straight seat tube, collar and fixed post; one continuous section-shaped saddle has a narrow waist and raised front/rear ends. All geometry is newly authored: no old bicycle frame or wheel mesh is imported, deleted or rearranged. There is no remote bottom bracket, chain, steering tube, handlebar, counter case or long staff. This common wheel/pedal axis and directly above fork/seat relationship is the whole model, not merely a wheel-count change to a reused bicycle. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres, Z up, whole XY-bounds centred and finite tyre facet at Z0. One prop, zero scenes. Static illustrative pose only, not a balanced physical rest-state simulation; no rider, animation, rotation, rideability, balancing, ergonomics, load, manufacture or sporting-safety claim.
